blind.details: There are no visible texts, labels, or watermarks. The image features a single composite object: an ornate gothic-style memento mori sculpture or decorative hourglass figurine. It consists of a carved black raven with detailed plumage perched on top, claws gripping the upper disc of an hourglass. The hourglass contains a clear glass vessel partially filled with sand in both upper and lower bulbs, supported by dark turned pillars with gold-toned bands, and draped in a carved off-white cloth. Flanking the glass are carved stylized laurel leaves. The entire structure rests on a tiered, multifaceted base combining dark grey stone and veined ivory or cream marble-like material, accented with a central circular emblem featuring a three-leaf design in bronze or gold. The object has no doors, drawers, lids, or wheels. The materials appear to be carved stone, resin, glass, and sand in a palette of matte charcoal black, antique cream, and muted gold. The object is entirely contained within the frame against an isolated, uniform white background with minimal soft shadow beneath.
